step 33: add the operators' keys

present: swap: on
present: package: nftables installed
present: apparmor: rootlesskit's profile is loaded
present: egress: the host's on-link IPv6 prefixes, dropped: 2001:db8:1::/64
present: br_netfilter: nf_tables, which the host's iptables uses, is loaded
present: daemon: /home (ext2/ext3) has 42.9 GB free
present: mesh: nothing on this host overlaps 10.44.0.0/24
present: firewall: ufw active, its default policy left to the owner
warning: forwarding: this turns on routing between every interface on this host
  The site has an endpoint, so it relays mesh traffic between sites behind NAT, which cannot dial each other. The firewall's forward policy governs what is routed.
warning: web server: its admin API did not answer on localhost:2019
  Admit records what it could tell; paisans web-server show asks you for the rest when the operators run it.
